# Departify — Full Reference

> Business Operating System. Quiet, structural, and built to scale.

Departify operates a company through an Executive Director and a roster of intelligent business departments. Each department is an independent AI team with its own director, specialised members, brand memory, tasks, deliverables, and a three-level permission system: `can`, `approval`, `never`. The default stance is conservative: destructive or externally-visible actions always require human approval.

The product is positioned for founders and operating teams who want to delegate operational work to structured AI teams without losing control. It is not a chatbot, not a single-agent tool, and not a workflow automation suite — it is an operating model.

## Company

- Legal name: Departify, S.L.
- Country: España
- Founded: 2025
- Website: https://departify.app
- Email: hola@departify.app

- Social: https://www.linkedin.com/company/departify · https://x.com/departify

## How it works

1. The customer chooses a plan and a department. The purchase happens online with no mandatory sales calls.
2. A private instance is provisioned: dedicated resources, isolated database, customer-specific encryption keys.
3. An Onboarding Director runs a guided conversation to understand the company, brand voice, goals and operating rules.
4. Connections are set up to internal tools (CRM, accounting, comms, channels).
5. The department starts operating inside the company, producing real work and awaiting human approval where required.

Average time from purchase to first mission: under one hour.

## Permission model (default for every department)

| Level | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `can` | The department acts without asking. | Investigate market and competitors; draft content. |
| `approval` | The department proposes and waits for human sign-off. | Publish to social channels; modify CRM; send emails. |
| `never` | The department does not have access. | Execute payments; sign contracts; delete customer data. |

The three levels are visible to the customer before purchase and editable after provisioning.

## Security posture

- Each customer runs on an isolated instance with dedicated resources.
- Encryption keys are unique per instance and customer-controlled.
- Data is partitioned per company; no cross-customer leakage.
- Every sensitive action goes through the approval layer.
- Audit log of every privileged action is available to the admin role.

## Pricing

Three plans (monthly or annual, no lock-in). Card, bank transfer (annual) and SEPA (European companies) accepted. Detailed plans are listed at https://departify.app/precios.

## API & integrations

The Executive Director coordinates internal departments. Each department integrates with a curated set of channels (Telegram, web panel) and external tools (CRMs, accounting, marketing platforms). A typed internal API is documented at https://departify.app/docs (private).

## Public routes

- `/` — Home
- `/departamentos` — Catalogue of all departments
- `/departamentos/[slug]` — Department detail
- `/precios` — Plans
- `/como-funciona` — Onboarding flow
- `/seguridad` — Security posture
- `/demo` — Interactive panel preview
- `/recursos` — Guides and case studies
- `/contacto` — Contact form
- `/privacidad`, `/terminos`, `/cookies` — Legal

The areas `/admin/*` and `/panel/*` are reserved for authenticated users and are not indexed.

## Differentiators (vs. chatbots, single-agent tools, automation suites)

1. **Structural, not conversational.** A department is a team, not a chat window.
2. **Permissioned by default.** Three levels enforced across every action.
3. **Customer-owned instance.** Encryption keys, database and memory leave with the customer.
4. **Executive Director layer.** Departments coordinate; they don't operate in silos.
5. **Operational depth.** Designed for sustained operating work, not one-off prompts.
